lines.t: Verse 1:
One cannot stand this Holy Fire
Spewed from His mouth, made by God's hand
A mighty army of the Lord
They will sing with a holy armor shield and sword
Chorus:
Built with the breastplate of the Lord
And they will fight in one accord
The tribe of Levi will stand
A man of God's holy command
Verse 2:
To march with victory and might
He will speak God's word and fight
With Holy Fire they will fall
Upon the wicked, great and small
Chorus:
Built with the breastplate of the Lord
And they will fight in one accord
The tribe of Levi will stand
A man of God's holy command
Bridge:
A mighty army made by God's hand
Armored, united, by the Lord's command
Shielded, wielding Spirit's sword
Their song resounds as one accord
Outro (optional):
Holy Fire, Holy command
Levi’s tribe will always stand
Mighty warriors of the Word
Bringers of God’s righteous sword
Holy Fire, Holy command
Levi’s tribe will always stand
Mighty warriors of the Word
Bringers of God’s righteous sword
Chorus:
Built with the breastplate of the Lord
And they will fight in one accord
The tribe of Levi will stand
A man of God's holy command
